sources.entry: ScreenKite - Native screen recorder and editor with auto-zoom, AI enhancements, device mockups, and teleprompter. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: ScreenKite
summary.one_liner: ScreenKite is a native macOS screen recorder and video editor with auto-zoom, AI-assisted editing, device mockups, and a teleprompter.
use_cases: Recording software demos and tutorials on a Mac
Adding automatic zoom to screen recordings
Making polished product demo or promo videos
summary.what_it_does: ScreenKite records the Mac screen and provides a built-in video editor in the same app. It follows the cursor and zooms in on clicks and keystrokes while recording, and the editor supports cutting and adding captions before export. The page says AI-assisted editing is available, with Claude Code and Codex able to drive the edit. It also lists device mockups and a teleprompter. The page claims exports finish 3x faster than Screen Studio on the same Mac, citing a benchmark.
notable: Auto-zoom follows cursor and keystrokes during recording
AI-assisted editing with Claude Code and Codex
Claims exports 3x faster than Screen Studio (vendor benchmark)
Listed in awesome-mac under Screen Recording as Freeware
caveats: A paid version without watermarks is mentioned in user posts, implying some features are paid
Speed comparison is the vendor's own claim
